content.short: yard[hub] web3 Growth Camp is a 12-week acceleration program covering all the bases of Web3 startup building.
content.description: Many projects that applied to yard[hub] web3 Growth Camp lacked essential elements like clear product-market fit, a viable business model, and a solid go-to-market strategy. Yard[hub] responds with an acceleration program designed to turn these ideas into ventures. The program features workshops and talks by mentors and experts from leading web3 companies, along with a learning platform that provides educational content and practical assignments. It helps teams go from 0 to 1.
